verdict.rationale: Asana is a SaaS product, so a published uptime SLA and a public incident status page are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack contains neither. The 'status updates' items describe project status reports inside Asana, not service-health or incident status, and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
